name: Mailer
description: Email sending through the Resend API for apps built around that service; for ordinary sending the email.send builtin uses the account in Settings.

credentials.name: api-key
credentials.label: Resend API key (resend.com, free tier works)

operations.name: mail.send
operations.description: Sends an email. Inputs from, to, subject, text; returns {id} on acceptance.

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: Sender, e.g. "App <onboarding@resend.dev>" (resend.dev senders work without domain setup)

operations.howto: Use only when the app is specifically about the Resend API; for ordinary "email this somewhere" apps prefer the email.send builtin, which uses the account from Settings and needs no key. Here all four inputs are required: bind from as a constant like "My App <onboarding@resend.dev>" (a verified sender), and the single output is "id", the acceptance id to show as the sent note. The API key is added once in the part's settings.
